beschreibung: G9 (#318) A2: 20 Hofaufträge als runde Vignetten (Anki-Medien, #270).
stil: Painterly warm oil vignette in a round composition on a dark warm brown background, storybook fairy-tale county, humorous but dignified: the described character (an anthropomorphic animal in medieval clothes, bust or half figure) or the described small landscape scene, centred with margin so it can be cropped to a circle. No text, no letters, no numbers.
